title: Flamengo and Corinthians Prepare for Maracanã Showdown
subtitle: Sunday's clash features differing strategies and standout players
excerpt: Flamengo, fresh off a victory against Independiente del Valle in Quito, and Corinthians, possibly debuting young defender Iago Machado, prepare for Sunday's clash at.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Sunday's clash between Flamengo and Corinthians, scheduled for 5:30 PM at the Maracanã, has garnered attention due to both coaches' lineup decisions. Flamengo just defeated Independiente del Valle 2-0 in Quito, and coach Leonardo Jardim admits he might rest players due to physical fatigue and the short recovery period.

Flamengo Considers Resting Players After Altitude Match

After landing in Rio de Janeiro, Leonardo Jardim acknowledged that the athletes had an intense day of work at 2,850 meters of altitude. Therefore, he might sideline some starters for the match against Corinthians, which will be the last Brasileirão game before the return leg of the Libertadores.

Iago Machado Could Debut in Corinthians' Defense

Coach Fernando Diniz might promote the debut of 17-year-old young defender Iago Machado against Flamengo. Iago played 24 games in the U-20, with four goals and two assists, and could form the defensive duo with João Pedro Tchoca.

Key Players in the Match

For Flamengo, Pedro, who started on the bench in Ecuador, has a strong chance of starting. Samuel Lino could also be a standout, with five goals in the last six games. For Corinthians, the match might be marked by Iago Machado's debut.

Brasileirão Standings Impact

Flamengo enters the match with 54 points, ahead of Palmeiras with 53. Corinthians, with 32 points, is still fighting in the middle of the table. A Flamengo victory would maintain their leadership in the 27th round.

Upcoming Engagements

Flamengo will have the return leg against Independiente del Valle next Thursday, at 9:30 PM, also at the Maracanã. Corinthians, on the other hand, will face Estudiantes in the return leg of the Libertadores, which might influence their lineup at the Maracanã.
